claims.text: Four checks, in order, for a zero suggestion.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §9 Where a zero comes from

claims.note: Order checked against production. Check 1 (wetter than target) is the only one that makes Suggested itself 0 under Option 2, so it rightly comes first (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3037-3039). Check 2 (threshold) explains a 0 at Lynx and in the push dialog while the table shows a non-zero value. Check 3 (disabled) does not produce a zero: a disabled station is still calculated and Lynx keeps its value (see station-zero/3/2). Check 4 (stale scan) explains an estimated or missing value. One cause is missing: under Option 1, a station Lynx holds at 0 percent stays at 0 (calculation-methods/3/5). See docs/claims/calculations.md §9.

claims.text: A zero suggestion is usually correct.

evidence.ref: docs/claims/calculations.md §9 Where a zero comes from

claims.note: The code makes a zero the correct output of its own arithmetic when the station is wetter than target by more than today's crop-adjusted ET. How often zeros in the field have that cause, rather than settings or stale data, is not something the source can settle.

claims.text: Check the minimum threshold
In [[Settings]], on the [[Minimum Threshold]] tab, read the [[Minimum Threshold (%)]] box and the option below it.
claims.note: Settings is STRINGS.SETTINGS; Minimum Threshold is a hardcoded rail title of the Settings dialog (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:54); Minimum Threshold (%) is SETTINGS_MIN_THRESHOLD (en-us.json:469). Reworded from minimum-threshold/1/1, minimum-threshold/1/2, station-zero/2/1, station-zero/2/2.

claims.text: The box reads 0, or reads less than the station’s [[% Adj.]], so the threshold is not the cause.
claims.note: The threshold rewrites only a pending station whose non-zero % Adj. is below it, and at 0 the feature is off, so neither case explains the zero. Reworded from station-zero/2/2, station-zero/2/3, minimum-threshold/before/4.

claims.text: If [[Set to zero when pushed to Lynx]] is selected, small changes go to Lynx as 0.
claims.note: With Set to zero when pushed to Lynx selected, a below-threshold change is sent as 0 while the table keeps the raw value. Reworded from station-zero/2/2, station-zero/2/5.

claims.text: To keep those stations running, select [[Set to the minimum threshold value when pushed to Lynx]], then select [[Save Changes]].
claims.note: The second option lifts below-threshold values to the threshold, and Save Changes saves every tab of Settings together. Reworded from station-zero/2/4, ~minimum-threshold:One save for every tab.

claims.text: Set to zero when pushed to Lynx converts small adjustments into zeros.
